instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. In an outdoor covered concrete pavilion, the man in the beige t-shirt (R1) is on the left, back partially to the camera, shifting his weight in black sweatpants and grey sneakers as he prepares to strike. On the right, the man in the green long-sleeved shirt (R3) stands in red shorts and grey clogs, holding up two focus mitts to face R1. The two maintain an active training stance, preparing for another round of boxing drills under bright, natural daylight.

R3 is the target-holder absorbing R1's boxing drill rather than the striker

the scene is an outdoor covered concrete pavilion
